title: Paul settles salvation.
paragraphs:
Paul settles salvation.
James examines evidence.

Grace is the root.
Works are the fruit.

You are not saved by works.
But you will be evaluated for them.

Not for heaven or hell.
But for reward or loss.

The cross decides your eternity.
Your obedience shapes your inheritance.

One courtroom determines identity.
Another reviews stewardship.

Salvation is a gift.
Rewards are earned.

Both are biblical.
Neither contradicts the other.
